records.source: Oh, I'm so glad the family was alright in the end. And the cows, too!$h
records.translation: Ồ, tôi mừng vì cuối cùng gia đình vẫn ổn. Cả đàn bò nữa!$h

records.source: I'm pretty easy-going when it comes to movies... I like just about everything!
records.translation: Về phim ảnh thì tôi khá dễ tính... gần như phim nào cũng thích!

records.source: I had a great time, @! Thanks for thinking of me.
records.translation: Tôi vui lắm, @! Cảm ơn vì đã nghĩ đến tôi.

records.source: Buh... Yeah, I guess this might be okay. *sniff* *sniff* ... a snack might help.
records.translation: Hừ... Ừ, chắc phim này cũng được. *khịt mũi* *khịt mũi* ... có đồ ăn thì dễ xem hơn.

records.source: I'm rooting for the villain... *urp*
records.translation: Tôi đang cổ vũ phe phản diện... *ợ*

records.source: Okay, I'll admit... I thought it was pretty good.
records.translation: Được rồi, tôi thừa nhận... phim khá hay.

records.source: Heh. I'm actually interested in seeing this one...
records.translation: Hề. Thật ra tôi cũng muốn xem phim này...

records.source: Okay, this is good...$h
records.translation: Được, phim hay đấy...$h

records.source: Shane's trying not to smile.
records.translation: Shane đang cố nhịn cười.

records.source: When you're watching a good movie, you can forget about everything else... That's a gift.
records.translation: Khi xem một bộ phim hay, ta có thể quên hết mọi chuyện khác... Đó là một món quà.

records.source: Buh... Yeah, I guess this might be okay. *sniff* *sniff* ... a snack might help.
records.translation: Hừ... Ừ, chắc phim này cũng được. *khịt mũi* *khịt mũi* ... có đồ ăn thì dễ xem hơn.

records.source: Okay, I'll admit... I thought it was pretty good.
records.translation: Được rồi, tôi thừa nhận... phim khá hay.

records.source: Ugh... this is going to be painful.
records.translation: Ặc... phen này khổ rồi.

records.source: Shane's slumped over...
records.translation: Shane đang gục xuống...

records.source: I feel depressed...$s
records.translation: Tôi thấy chán nản quá...$s

records.source: I'm really happy to see a movie!
records.translation: Em vui lắm vì được xem phim!

records.source: Jas is ecstatic!
records.translation: Jas đang sung sướng tột độ!

records.source: That was so much fun! Thanks for bringing me!$h
records.translation: Vui quá! Cảm ơn đã đưa em đi!$h

records.source: This is a grown-up movie, right? I'll be okay!
records.translation: Đây là phim người lớn, đúng không? Em sẽ ổn thôi!

records.source: Jas is nodding and glancing sideways.
records.translation: Jas đang gật gù và liếc sang bên.
